scripts.build:web: cd web && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names build,server --prefix-colors blue,green "npm:build:watch" "nodemon --watch server --ext js,cjs,json server/server.js"
scripts.devAll: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names app,grapheditor,design,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,cyan,yellow "PORT=3000 npm run dev" "PORT=8088 npm --prefix GraphEditor run dev" "PORT=4000 npm run dev:design" "npm run build:web && PORT=3001 npx serve web -l 3001"
